assessment.summary: Generation needs one bounded API owner with uniform basis sampling and metadata-only collision fallback.

nonNegotiables: No injectable or replaceable entropy source
No accepted basis is discarded because derived public metadata collides
assumptions: Supported runtimes are CPython 3.12 through 3.14 with a functioning operating-system CSPRNG.
Typed or parsed MasterSeed input is treated as securely generated; the artifact cannot prove provenance.

opportunities.title: Centralize and bound electronic generation
opportunities.summary: Move entropy, basis acceptance, identifier policy, and output selection behind one audited API boundary.
opportunities.diagnosis: The pre-Gate-3 CLI owns generation and mixes entropy, metadata, interpolation, and presentation, while public generation invariants are absent.

evidence.claim: CLI helpers independently sample each payload character, build bases, derive identifiers, and select canonical outputs.
BIP93 defines fresh generation as k independent random shares and existing-secret generation as S plus k-1 random shares.
Rejecting accepted masks after a derived identifier collision conditions returned default outputs; changing only public metadata avoids that bias.

desiredInvariants: Each attempted basis consumes one batch of uniform u5 mask symbols from the OS CSPRNG.
Fresh padding rejection preserves every sub-threshold share projection.
Explicit header collisions fail before entropy and derived collisions change metadata only.
Selectors and exclusions are bounded and validated before generation.
API and CLI return the requested or CSPRNG sample order unchanged.

options.title: Use independent random identifiers
options.summary: Generate all identifiers independently from the seed and masks.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: This removes fingerprint disclosure but gives up the selected deterministic disambiguation behavior.

tradeoffs.assessment: Independent identifiers reveal no seed-fingerprint predicate.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Audit every identifier call site for independence from S and shares.

tradeoffs.assessment: Four extra CSPRNG bytes are immaterial.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Exercise generation across all profiles and thresholds.

tradeoffs.assessment: Only four identifier symbols are retained.
Collision handling remains bounded but deterministic wallet/set recognition disappears.
Users lose the selected default metadata signal for recognizing wallet and set membership.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Conduct user testing before changing the accepted policy.

tradeoffs.assessment: It changes the accepted legacy identifier policy and frozen fixtures.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Compare generated headers with prior electronic generation behavior.

residualRisks: Independent identifiers still disclose that strings share one public set header.

workPackages: Replace fingerprint helpers with four random u5 symbols.
acceptanceCriteria: No identifier value depends on secret or share payloads.
migrationNotes: Existing deterministic defaults would no longer be reproduced.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Restore the reviewed deterministic metadata policy.

options.title: Fail or regenerate on a default collision
options.summary: Keep deterministic defaults but discard a colliding attempt or ask the user to rerun.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: It handles the visible collision but conditions which default bases are returned.

tradeoffs.assessment: Successful default outputs are conditioned on the identifier predicate and the collision branch leaks that predicate.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Formally compare unconditional and collision-conditioned output distributions.

tradeoffs.assessment: A collision repeats full basis generation or a complete user workflow.
A retry need not retain the prior basis.
TTY and non-TTY retries can diverge and interrupted workflows discard accepted secrets.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Exercise collision behavior in interactive and piped modes.

tradeoffs.assessment: The user must understand and resolve a metadata collision after secret generation.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Review CLI diagnostics and interrupted flows.

tradeoffs.assessment: Normal noncollision headers retain the legacy default.

workPackages: Add collision failure and retry guidance.

options.title: Retain the basis and replace colliding metadata
options.summary: Centralize generation, keep the reviewed deterministic default, and randomize only a colliding identifier.

evidenceCoverage.rationale: This implements the selected API while avoiding basis conditioning and unbounded collision retries.

tradeoffs.assessment: One owner enforces uniform masks and metadata-only fallback, though deterministic identifiers retain an accepted 20-bit disclosure.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Independently audit every CSPRNG, padding, identifier, and reheader path.

tradeoffs.assessment: Batch mask sampling reduces calls; padding rejection remains bounded in expectation.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Exercise worst padding width and 31-output generation without timing claims.

tradeoffs.assessment: One complete hidden basis is held while output shares are selected.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Inspect that rejected and returned bases are not persisted.

tradeoffs.assessment: Collision handling is noninteractive and never loses the accepted basis.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Force default collision through fixed metadata fixtures and verify payload preservation.

tradeoffs.assessment: API and CLI return one complete ordered result without continuation state.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run the complete CLI create matrix.

tradeoffs.assessment: Normal defaults preserve the full-20 and legacy 10+10 fixtures while unsafe helpers are removed.
tradeoffs.validationPlan: Run frozen identifier and existing CLI regression fixtures.

residualRisks: Fingerprint identifiers leak a public seed predicate.
The implementation trusts CPython and operating-system entropy.
Typed MasterSeed provenance cannot be proven.

workPackages: Implement uniform hidden bases and padding rejection.
Route CLI create through the API.
Add direct tests and independent implementation audit.
acceptanceCriteria: No medium-or-higher unaccepted implementation finding remains.
migrationNotes: Raw byte seeds require an explicit identifier.
implementationReadiness.rollback: Revert Gate 3 as one unit; do not restore unsafe public factories.

opportunities.recommendation: Use metadata-only fallback under the accepted usability policy; choose independent random identifiers if eliminating the 20-bit disclosure becomes more important than deterministic disambiguation.
